title: Returns Policy
content: Customers may return eligible electronics within 30 days of delivery if the product and accessories meet the return conditions.

title: Refund Timeline
content: Approved refunds are normally processed within 5 to 7 business days after validation.

title: Delivery FAQ
content: Delivery dates depend on customer location, inventory availability and courier capacity.

title: Laptop Warranty
content: Selected laptops include a one-year limited manufacturer warranty.

title: Premium Customer Policy
content: Premium customers receive priority routing but still follow the same privacy and authorization rules.

title: Address Change
content: Delivery-address changes are allowed only before shipment is handed to the courier.

title: Replacement Policy
content: Approved replacements depend on stock availability and return validation.
